title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) & Post-Matric Scholarships
target_audience: School and college students from SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and EWS categories.
benefits: Direct financial grant of ₹3,000 to ₹50,000 per year covering tuition fees, books, and hostel allowances directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility: Students enrolled in recognized schools, colleges, or ITIs with family annual income generally below ₹2.5 Lakh (varies by scheme).
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Caste/Category Certificate, Previous Year Marksheet, Fee Receipt, Bank Passbook.
how_to_apply: Register online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal) with OTR (One Time Registration) before annual cut-off dates.

title: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Free Skill Courses
target_audience: Youth, school dropouts, and unemployed individuals seeking vocational jobs.
benefits: 100% free industry-certified skill training (e.g. Electrician, Solar Technician, Healthcare Assistant, Tailoring, Digital Data Entry) with stipend and placement assistance.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 15-45 with basic schooling. No fee required.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account, educational qualification certificate (8th/10th/12th if applicable).
how_to_apply: Find nearest Skill India Training Centre at skillindiadigital.gov.in or visit district PMKK (Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra).

title: Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Portal
target_audience: Students pursuing higher education in India or abroad needing low-interest education loans.
benefits: Single-window portal to apply for education loans across 40+ national and private banks with Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) for low-income families.
eligibility: Students who secured admission to higher education courses through merit or entrance exams.
documents_needed: Admission letter, Fee structure breakdown, 10th/12th/Graduation marksheet, Parent's income proof, KYC documents.
how_to_apply: Create an account on vidyalakshmi.co.in, fill Common Educational Loan Application Form (CELAF), and select target banks.

title: SWAYAM & NPTEL Free Online Learning & Certification
target_audience: Students, teachers, and lifelong learners wanting free courses from IITs, IIMs, and NCERT.
benefits: Access to high-quality video lectures, reading materials, and tests for Classes 9 to Post-Graduation completely free. Transferable college credits available.
eligibility: Open to everyone across India with an internet connection.
documents_needed: Email ID or Mobile number for account creation.
how_to_apply: Visit swayam.gov.in or download SWAYAM app and enroll in any course for free.

title: Jawaharlal Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) Free Residential Schooling
target_audience: Talented rural children entering Class 6 and Class 9.
benefits: 100% free high-quality CBSE education, boarding, lodging, uniforms, and textbooks from Class 6 to 12. 75% seats reserved for rural students.
eligibility: Students studying in Class 5 in recognized rural schools of the respective district.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Rural area school certificate, Residence certificate, Birth certificate.
how_to_apply: Register online for JNV Selection Test (JNVST) on navodaya.gov.in through school principal or CSC.

title: Board Exam Preparation & Stress Management Support
target_audience: Students preparing for 10th/12th Board exams, NEET, or JEE experiencing anxiety.
benefits: Guidance on study scheduling (25-min Pomodoro cycles), solving previous 5 years' papers, revision routines, and mental health tele-counseling support.
eligibility: All students and parents across India.
how_to_apply: Call Tele-MANAS helpline 14416 or CBSE Student Counseling helpline during exam seasons.

title: Government ITI & Polytechnic Diploma Admissions
target_audience: 10th and 12th pass students wanting job-oriented practical technical diplomas.
benefits: Affordable 1 to 3 year hands-on technical trades (Fitter, Motor Mechanic, Draughtsman, Civil/Electrical Diploma) with direct apprenticeship opportunities.
eligibility: Passed 8th, 10th, or 12th standard depending on the specific trade.
documents_needed: 10th Marksheet, Domicile Certificate, Category Certificate, Aadhaar Card.
how_to_apply: Apply through your respective State Directorate of Technical Education / ITI admission portal during May-July.

title: PM SHRI Modernized Government Schools
target_audience: Primary and secondary school students in government school networks.
benefits: Smart classrooms, experiential science labs, robotics kits, and modern sports infrastructure inside upgraded government schools.
eligibility: Children residing near designated PM SHRI school zones.
documents_needed: Birth Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Previous class Transfer Certificate (TC).
how_to_apply: Visit the local Government PM SHRI school in your block or village for direct enrollment.

title: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) for Tribal Students
target_audience: Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in remote and tribal blocks.
benefits: Completely free CBSE education from Class 6 to 12, residential accommodation, nutritional meals, sports coaching, and competitive exam preparation.
eligibility: ST boys and girls who clear the EMRS entrance test for Class 6.
documents_needed: ST Caste Certificate, Domicile, 5th standard marksheet, Aadhaar Card.
how_to_apply: Apply through emrs.tribal.gov.in or district tribal welfare office.

title: AICTE Saksham & Pragati Scholarships for Girls and Differently-Abled
target_audience: Girl students and specially-abled students pursuing Technical Degree or Diploma courses.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of technical study towards college fees, laptop purchase, and books.
eligibility: Girl students (Pragati) or differently-abled students with >40% disability (Saksham) admitted to AICTE approved technical institutes.
documents_needed: Admission letter, Disability certificate (if applicable), Income certificate (<₹8 Lakh), Aadhaar.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) under AICTE schemes.
